Author: LunaBelleElite
Name: Luna Shopping List
Description: Builds a price-optimised shopping list, grouped by world, from an Artisan crafting list using current Universalis prices.
Punchline: Builds a price-optimised shopping list from an Artisan crafting list.
Changelog: First public release, an early preview: list browser, one window per list, and a results window where you choose the world for each item, with cheapest and fewest-worlds starting plans.
